jobs.description:
ABOUT ZOLVE
Welcome to the financial frontier of limitless possibilities - welcome to Zolve. We're not just a fintech; we're architects of a financial revolution, crafting a narrative that transcends borders. At Zolve, we believe in rewriting the rules of finance to empower global citizens, nomads, and dreamers to navigate the world without constraints.
Zolve is the world's first cross border neo-bank which helps migrants get access to credit in the new country based on their home country credit score. Zolve’s cross-border capabilities enable global citizens to access financial products such as checking accounts, credit cards, remittances, insurances, and loans seamlessly, helping them to be financially free to pursue their ambitions, without limiting the services to a particular country. 
As we continue to grow into multiple geographies, product lines and customer segments, we are seeking a dynamic individual to join us and support our journey. 
JOB DESCRIPTION
Role: Business Development Associates– Study Abroad Partnership
Location: Pan India( Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kerala, Delhi, Mumbai, Gujarat, Punjab, Nepal).
Employment Type: Full-Time
Join our BDA Team .We are expanding our partnerships team and looking for passionate professionals who can drive growth by building and managing relationships in the study-abroad ecosystem.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Build, manage, and nurture relationships with study abroad affiliates, counsellors,  loan providers, and visa counsellors.
Drive acquisition of student leads through affiliate and counsellor networks.
Pitch and sell Zolve’s financial solutions (Education Loans, Credit Cards, Forex
Cards, International SIMs, Accommodation Assistance, Insurance, etc.) to students and professionals planning to move abroad.
 Act as a trusted partner to affiliates, ensuring smooth coordination and       high-quality lead flow.
Meet and exceed monthly/quarterly sales and partnership targets, aligned with reward structures.
Conduct regular partner visits, presentations, and training sessions.
Represent Zolve at industry events, student fairs, and partner activations
QUALIFICATIONS
Education : Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred.
Experience : 
2–5 years in business development, partnerships, or sales within the study abroad, education, or financial services industry. 
Prior experience in managing affiliates, counsellors, loan partners, or visa consultants is essential. 
A proven track record in selling to international students or immigrants will be a strong plus. 
Hands-on with CRM tools like Salesforce, Zoho and Excel. 
Excellent communication and negotiation skills in English; knowledge of a regional language is an added advantage. 
Comfortable with travel-intensive roles and dynamic fieldwork. 
Target-driven, goal-oriented, and able to thrive in a high-performance culture.

The Study Abroad Advisor plays a vital role in assisting and helping students who want to study abroad with their easy or hassle-free visa application or paperwork processing. A consultant’s responsibility is to work and coordinate with the student and the university to obtain their acceptance and to answer any questions or doubts they may have about studying abroad.
Job Description:
Assisting students from start to end of the entire admission process and providing a fair and neutral evaluation of a candidate’s profile.
The overseas education adviser will first assess the student’s profile before recommending the best programme options and other jobs suitable for a career;
Providing information about the various international colleges and universities and advising them about various requirements.
Providing students with the most up-to-date knowledge and information about universities.
Responsible for guiding the students regarding their overseas career decisions and helping them understand their potential and help to pursue their goals.
The advisor shall assist students in choosing the appropriate university along with the program courses (Subjects) that has global recognition and offers valuable education so that a student can take a fair decision to enroll with the University;
Helping the students understand their skill sets and provide those ways to utilize it.
Interview and Preparing students to ensure that he/she is eligible to apply for application
Consultants will have to assist students in completing admission forms and preparing financial documentation;
The consultant will convey the requirement of the shortlisted documents to the students to collect and assemble each document beforehand and take care of the financial aid process, considering every aspect of the students;
The advisor will educate the student about education loans and assist them in obtaining loans and financial aid.
Understanding the extent of students’ study fields and being aware of the actual professional aim driving their decision to study abroad;
Need to assist students to prepare an excellent, honest, appealing SOP;
Once the university enrolls or sends an acceptance letter to the student, the consultant will still provide the assistance needed like accommodation, lifestyle and managing finances, etc.
Pre-departure counseling to ensure student expectations are commensurate with reality.
Delivery of outstanding client service which is paramount to not only the success of a case but is intrinsic to the culture and values of VIAVIA.
Achieve excellent customer service by proactively responding to client queries and advising customers on their overseas immigration and visa needs.
Preferred Skills and Experience:
Excellent Communication Skills, Convincing Skills and problem solving Skills with ability to communicate at all levels.
Self-motivated, sales focused and result oriented professional with an ability to deliver under pressure
Attention to detail, ability to retain high levels of concentration
Should possess a Pleasing, Warm and Friendly personality with Professional Mannerism
Passionate to learn and grow with the company
Result-orientated along with Positive Attitude.
Minimum two years of experience.
Prior experience in Overseas Education Counseling.
Ability to communicate effectively and concisely to customers
Excellent problem-solving and customer service skills.

# Sales & Service Executive – ERP Software
**Locations:** Malappuram | Palakkad | Coimbatore
**Work Mode:** Hybrid / Field + Office
**Employment Type:** Full-time
**Experience:** 0–3 years
**Industry:** ERP / Software / B2B
## Job Summary
We are looking for a motivated and customer-focused **Sales & Service Executive** to join our ERP software team in **Malappuram, Palakkad, Calicut and Coimbatore**.
The role combines **ERP software sales, customer service, product demonstrations, client support and relationship management**.
The candidate will be responsible for identifying potential customers, understanding their business requirements, demonstrating ERP solutions, generating sales, supporting existing customers and coordinating with the technical team for issue resolution.
**Freshers are welcome. Training will be provided.**

- Identify and approach potential ERP customers in the assigned territory
- Generate leads through calls, field visits, references and business networking
- Visit textile shops, retail businesses, wholesalers and other potential customers

- Recommend suitable ERP modules and solutions
- Conduct online and onsite ERP product demonstrations
- Prepare quotations and proposals
- Follow up with prospects and convert leads into customers
- Negotiate with customers and support sales closure

- Conduct customer visits when required
- Collect customer feedback
- Identify customer satisfaction issues and escalate when necessary
- Identify opportunities for **AMC renewal, upselling and cross-selling**
- Promote additional ERP modules and services
### Implementation & Onboarding
- Coordinate with the implementation team during new customer onboarding
- Assist customers with initial ERP setup and training
- Understand customer workflows and communicate requirements to the internal team
- Support customers during the initial implementation period
- Ensure smooth transition from sales to service

The Sales & Service Executive will be expected to manage activities such as:
- New customer calls
- Lead generation
- Customer visits
- ERP demonstrations
- Quotations
- Sales follow-ups
- Existing customer support
- Service requests
- Customer training
- AMC follow-ups
- Upselling / cross-selling
- Daily activity reporting
## Required Skills
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good Malayalam and English communication
- **Tamil communication is an advantage for Coimbatore**
- Ability to explain software to non-technical users
- Strong customer handling skills
- Good follow-up and negotiation ability
- Basic computer knowledge
- Willingness to travel for customer visits
- Positive attitude and willingness to learn
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team
## Preferred / Added Advantage
- Experience in ERP/software sales or support
- B2B sales or customer service experience
- Experience with textile or retail businesses
- Knowledge of Accounting, Inventory, Sales, Purchase or GST
- Experience conducting software demonstrations
- Experience in customer onboarding or implementation
- Experience handling AMC customers
- Existing business contacts in Malappuram, Palakkad or Coimbatore
- Valid driving licence and willingness to travel
## Education Qualification
Any Graduate
**B.Com / BBA / BCA / B.Sc / MBA** candidates preferred.
## Freshers Welcome
Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
Training will be provided in:
- ERP software
- Accounting & business workflows
- Inventory management
- Sales & Purchase
- GST
- ERP demonstrations
- Customer support
- Customer handling
- Sales process
## What We Offer
- Fixed salary + **performance-based sales incentives**
- ERP product training
- Customer service and sales training
- Career growth opportunities
- Opportunity to build a career in the ERP/software industry
- Professional and supportive work environment
## Career Growth
**Sales & Service Executive → Senior Sales & Service Executive → Sales Manager → Regional Sales Manager**
## Ideal Candidate
We are looking for someone who enjoys both **sales and customer interaction**.
The ideal candidate should be comfortable with:
**Lead Generation → Customer Visit → Requirement Understanding → ERP Demo → Sales Closure → Implementation Coordination → Customer Support → AMC & Upselling**
Candidates who enjoy **meeting customers, travelling, explaining software, solving customer problems and achieving sales targets** are encouraged to apply.

You will work closely with customers to understand their goals, support onboarding and adoption, identify growth opportunities, and build strong, long-term relationships.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to use data to identify opportunities and make recommendations.

About the Role Our client, a prominent name in the Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) industry, is seeking an insightful and detail-oriented Market Research Executive to join their team in **Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu**. This role is fundamental to understanding consumer behavior, market trends, and competitive dynamics, providing essential data-driven insights to inform strategic decision-making across marketing, product development, and sales. You will be responsible for designing and conducting market research studies, analyzing data, interpreting findings, and presenting actionable recommendations to stakeholders. The ideal candidate possesses a strong analytical mindset, excellent research skills, and a passion for uncovering consumer motivations within the FMCG sector. This position offers a challenging yet rewarding opportunity to contribute directly to the success of our client's brands by ensuring they remain relevant and competitive. We are looking for an individual who can translate complex data into clear, concise, and impactful insights that guide business strategy in the vibrant **Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu** market. This is a ground-based role requiring on-site presence.
Key Responsibilities
Design and execute quantitative and qualitative market research projects, including surveys, focus groups, and in-depth interviews.
Collect, analyze, and interpret market data related to consumer behavior, purchasing patterns, and brand perception.
Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and emerging opportunities within the FMCG landscape.
Prepare comprehensive research reports, presentations, and dashboards summarizing key findings and actionable insights.
Collaborate with marketing, product development, and sales teams to define research objectives and translate insights into business strategies.
Manage relationships with external research agencies and vendors as needed.
Stay updated on the latest market research methodologies, tools, and technologies.
Contribute to the development of consumer segmentation and profiling models.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of all collected and analyzed data.
Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Statistics, Economics, Sociology, Psychology, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus.
2-4 years of experience in market research, consumer insights, or a related analytical role, preferably within the FMCG industry.
Proven experience in designing and executing various research methodologies.
Strong analytical skills with proficiency in statistical software (e.g., SPSS, R) and data visualization tools.
Excellent report writing and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex findings clearly.
Proficiency in MS Office Suite, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Understanding of consumer behavior and market dynamics in the Indian context.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple research projects simultaneously.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Benefits
Competitive salary package aligned with industry standards.
Comprehensive health insurance and wellness benefits.
Opportunities for professional development and skill enhancement in market research.
Exposure to diverse FMCG product categories and strategic decision-making processes.
A collaborative and intellectually stimulating work environment.
Paid time off and company holidays.
Potential for career growth within the organization.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive – Inside Sales (B2B SaaS)
jobs.description:
Location: On-site, Cyberpark, Kozhikode, Kerala 
 Experience: 1–3 years in B2B sales, inside sales or lead generation 
 Type: Full time | Openings: 2
About Mailercloud 
Mailercloud is an email marketing platform used by businesses to send campaigns, automate customer emails and reach the inbox reliably. We are a UK-based company with offices in London and Kozhikode, serving customers in India, the UK and other markets. We are currently hiring for our Cyberpark, Kozhikode office; this is a full-time, on-site role. 
The role 
This is an outbound sales role. You will find the right companies, reach their decision-makers by phone, email and LinkedIn, and book qualified meetings for our Director of Sales, who runs the demo and closes the deal. 
You will not be doing field visits, and you will not be expected to close deals yourself. Your job is to start good conversations and fill the calendar. 
What you will do 
Research and build lists of target companies and the right people inside them. 
Make outbound calls every day to introduce Mailercloud and understand how the prospect handles email marketing today. 
Write and send personalised emails and LinkedIn messages, and follow up consistently. 
Qualify interest: company size, current tool, sending volume, and who decides. 
Book meetings for the Director of Sales and hand over clear notes before each one. 
Keep every call, email and outcome up to date in HubSpot CRM. 
Share what you hear from prospects so we can improve our messaging. 
What a normal week looks like 
Around 50 calls and 40 personalised emails a day. 
A target of 8–10 qualified meetings booked each week once you are trained. 
A weekly review of your numbers with the Director of Sales. 
If this pace sounds energising rather than tiring, you will enjoy the job. 
Requirements
What we are looking for 
1–3 years of experience selling to businesses: inside sales, business development, lead generation or telesales. 
Comfort on the phone. You have made cold calls before and can hold a conversation with a business owner or manager. 
Clear written English. You can write a short email that gets a reply. 
Experience with any CRM. HubSpot, Zoho or Salesforce are all fine. 
A degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience. 
Willingness to work from our Kozhikode office. 
Good to have (not required) 
Experience selling software, SaaS or IT services. 
Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo or similar prospecting tools. 
Experience running email outreach sequences. 
Any background in email marketing or digital marketing. 
Benefits
A fixed monthly salary plus a monthly incentive tied to qualified meetings booked and revenue closed from them. 
Training on the product, on outbound selling and on the tools we use. 
Direct work with the Director of Sales, with a path to an Account Executive role for strong performers. 
A product company in Kozhikode, so you can build a SaaS sales career without moving to Bengaluru or Kochi. 
How to apply 
Apply with your CV. Shortlisted candidates will have a short screening call, followed by a practical exercise (a mock cold call and one outreach email), and a final interview.

jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior CRM Executive cum Sales Coordinator to manage our existing Zoho CRM Plus customer database and coordinate between customers, the sales team, support teams and management.
The role involves maintaining accurate customer records, ensuring every incoming enquiry is captured and assigned, tracking sales opportunities through closure, and coordinating customer support requirements. The candidate must take ownership of CRM discipline, follow-up tracking and timely reporting to support business growth and customer satisfaction
Key Roles and Responsibilities:
CRM and Customer Database Management
Maintain and update Zoho CRM Plus daily, including customer account names, contact persons, designations, telephone numbers, email addresses and locations.
Review existing records, remove duplicates, correct incomplete information and maintain consistent data standards.
Ensure leads, contacts, accounts and deals are linked correctly, converting qualified leads into the appropriate CRM records.
Record customer interactions, requirements, assigned sales personnel, next actions and follow-up dates.
Protect customer information and follow company procedures for CRM access and data handling.
Lead Management and Sales Coordination
Capture enquiries received through telephone, email, the website, campaigns, referrals and other company channels.
Verify basic customer requirements and promptly assign leads to the appropriate salesperson.
Monitor whether assigned leads are contacted and followed up within agreed timelines.
Track opportunities from initial enquiry through site visits, demonstrations, quotations, negotiations and order closure.
Coordinate with sales, presales and product teams to ensure customers receive timely proposals and clarifications.
Flag unattended leads, delayed quotations, overdue follow-ups and stalled opportunities to management.
Record reasons for lost opportunities and identify enquiries that can be reactivated.
Customer and Support Coordination
Act as a central coordination point for customer enquiries and status updates.
Route installation, service, warranty and support requests to the responsible teams.
Track pending customer issues, escalate delays and follow up until closure.
Coordinate with sales, support, operations and accounts on customer commitments, order status and payment follow-ups.
Identify renewal, repeat-business, cross-selling and upselling opportunities within the existing customer base.
Reporting and Performance Monitoring
Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports on leads, quotations, pipeline, conversions, orders and pending activities.
Maintain dashboards showing sales performance against targets and salesperson-wise follow-up status.
Track support requests, ageing issues and closure status.
Support management reviews by preparing accurate CRM reports and tracking agreed action points.
Encourage consistent CRM usage across the sales team and recommend improvements to workflows and reporting.
Required Skills and Qualifications
Graduate in any discipline with relevant CRM and sales coordination experience.
Minimum 3 years of practical experience using Zoho CRM, preferably Zoho CRM Plus.
Strong working knowledge of leads, contacts, accounts, deals, activities, workflows, reports and dashboards.
Experience handling a substantial customer database and coordinating with multiple salespeople.
Good Excel skills, including data cleaning, reconciliation and report preparation.
Strong communication skills in Tamil and English, both spoken and written.
Excellent follow-up, organisation, attention to detail and customer-handling skills.
Ability to prioritise multiple requirements and escalate issues promptly.
Experience in IT products, system integration, audiovisual solutions, networking or technical services is preferred.
Familiarity with Zoho Desk, Zoho Books and related Zoho applications is an added advantage.
Location and Availability
Candidates residing within a convenient commuting distance of our Greams Road, Chennai office will be preferred. Immediate joiners and candidates with a short notice period are encouraged to apply.
Performance Expectations
Success in this role will be measured through CRM data accuracy, timely lead assignment, follow-up compliance, visibility of the sales pipeline, timely reporting and effective coordination of customer support requests.

About Softpal
Softpal Technologies Private Limited is a Global Information Technology (IT) Services and Product Company. Our Standard Procedures and Processes enable our excellent team of Technology Professionals to provide cutting-edge IT Solutions to Enterprises worldwide, empowering them to utilize available resources and manage their operations effectively by improving efficiency, optimizing services, securing information, reducing costs, and improving profits.
Softpal is now leading the way in powering next-generation enterprises with its Products in the Arena of Supply Chain, Forensic Labs, Factory Automation, Crowd Loyalty, Cloud, Mobile Applications, Blockchain, Big Data, and Analytics Solutions. Leveraging our technology and domain knowledge prowess, we partner with our clients to create transformational value that provides sustainable competitive advantage in their respective market segments.

Opportunities for Employee Growth and Development include:
Career Development and Counseling Services
Opportunities for Promotion and Internal Career Advancement
Coaching, Mentoring, and Leadership Development Programs
Work Location: Hyderabad
Job Brief
We are looking for a motivated and result-oriented Business Development Executive to join our sales team. The Business Development Executive will play a fundamental role in achieving our ambitious customer acquisition and revenue growth objectives. The ideal candidate should be comfortable making outbound calls, generating interest, qualifying prospects, conducting product demonstrations, and closing sales opportunities.
You should possess excellent communication and customer service skills, understand customer requirements, and be capable of building strong business relationships. A successful Business Development Executive should be competitive, self-motivated, goal-oriented, and capable of consistently achieving sales targets.
Main Responsibilities and Duties
Source new sales opportunities through inbound lead follow-up, outbound cold calls, emails, business directories, web research, and digital channels
Build and manage a healthy sales pipeline and sales funnel
Qualify leads generated through digital campaigns, conferences, trade shows, referrals, and other marketing initiatives
Research accounts, identify key decision-makers, and generate business interest
Understand customer requirements and identify suitable solutions from Softpal's products and services portfolio
Generate revenue by soliciting and obtaining orders, understanding technical requirements, and providing appropriate information
Build and maintain strong customer relationships by offering solutions, support, and consultation
Develop new business opportunities by researching potential accounts and creating engagement strategies
Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations, and business communications
Conduct effective online and offline product demonstrations and presentations
Respond to customer inquiries through phone calls, emails, and other communication channels
Maintain and expand the prospect and customer database using CRM tools
Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and project handover
Stay updated on product enhancements, industry trends, competitor activities, and market opportunities
Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling products and services
Maintain accurate sales records, reports, and forecasting data
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets
Support marketing activities including trade shows, exhibitions, webinars, and promotional events
Contribute to departmental and organizational goals by taking ownership of assigned responsibilities
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's Degree (BA, BBA, B.Com, B.Sc, B.Tech, MBA Marketing, or equivalent)
Previous experience in outbound calling, inside sales, business development, or customer-facing roles preferred
Strong understanding of the sales cycle from lead generation to closure
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Excellent phone etiquette and cold-calling skills
Strong listening, presentation, negotiation, and persuasion skills
Ability to build rapport quickly with prospective customers
Strong customer service orientation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Zoho CRM, HubSpot, or similar tools
Proficiency in web presentation and virtual meeting tools
Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team
Self-motivated, energetic, and target-driven personality
Strong organizational and time-management skills
Ability to multitask, prioritize activities, and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
Positive attitude and resilience in handling objections and rejection
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
Ability to consistently achieve assigned sales targets and quotas
Required Experience: 0 to 1 Years
Education and Pass-out Criteria: Any Graduate
Compensation: 1.8 to 2.0 LPA
